start: A member finishes a routine they have done before (same exercises, some heavier, one with fewer sets)

steps.action: Tap Finish on the workout and land on the finish screen
user_sees: The comparison line against the last time of this routine
'See each exercise (n)' under the line, with a chevron on the right
must_not: No comparison when a previous workout of the routine exists
The words 'volume', 'PR' or 'session'

steps.action: Tap the comparison line
user_sees: 'Hide exercises'; the chevron turns
A 'Mostly <exercise>: 2 sets fewer.' line when the total moved 5% or more
One row per exercise with '+8%' in green or '-20%' in grey, and a reason such as '2.5 kg heavier' or '2 sets fewer'
must_not: A down row shown in red
A reason that points the other way from the row (a down row saying 'heavier')
Warm-up sets counted in the kg

steps.action: Tap the line again
user_sees: The list closes; 'See each exercise (n)' again
must_not: The list stuck open
The rows changed by opening and closing

start: Finish screen with a comparison line that opens the compared workout

steps.action: Tap 'See that workout' under the comparison line
user_sees: The saved workout the line compares with, its day and exercises
must_not: A different workout from the one the line names
The finish screen's own workout lost or unsaved

steps.action: Go back
user_sees: The finish screen again, with the same line
must_not: A second copy of today's workout
The comparison worked out again against another workout

start: Another kind: a body-weight workout (pull-ups, plank) logged with no kilos, done before

steps.action: Finish the workout and open 'See each exercise (n)'
user_sees: Rows measured by reps (or by sets for a hold) such as '+20%' with '3 more reps'
'same' when the reps are within 5%
must_not: Every body-weight row reading 'same' because the kg are zero
A 'kg heavier' reason for a move with no weight

start: First time this routine is done, or the Counting of an exercise changed since last time

steps.action: Finish a first-ever workout of a routine
user_sees: No 'See each exercise' list; today's total is the number to beat next time
must_not: A comparison against an unrelated workout
A list of rows all marked 'new' with no line above them

steps.action: Change an exercise's Counting (for example 'One side at a time'), do the routine again and finish
user_sees: No 'more than last time' or 'Lighter than last time' comparison at all
must_not: '+340 kg more than last time' for the same work
A sleep or protein hint under a comparison that was not fair

steps.action: Finish a workout in a planned easy week
user_sees: The note without the per-exercise list
must_not: Every exercise shown as down with a reason like '2 sets fewer' as if it were a failure

start: Today adds a new exercise and leaves out one from last time

steps.action: Finish and open 'See each exercise (n)'
user_sees: The new exercise tagged 'new' with 'Not in that workout'
The left-out exercise at the end, tagged 'not done' with 'Not done this time'
must_not: The left-out exercise missing from the list
A percent shown for a new or a left-out exercise

steps.action: Finish the same routine again next time with both done
user_sees: Both rows with a percent again
must_not: The exercise still marked 'new' or 'not done'

why_not: no sharing: the comparison is worked out on the phone from the member's own workouts and shown only on their finish screen (coachNote.ts:203-262)

note: Names wrap at 2 lines (CompareNote.tsx:29); reasons use '1 set' / '1 rep' singular (workoutCompare.ts:54-58)

why_not: no time edge: the compared workout is picked by routine, not by date (coachNote.ts:205)
read-only screen worked out from workouts already saved; leaving and coming back works it out again from the same rows

note: Weights in the reason follow the unit (coachNote.ts:258); the words 'set', 'heavier', 'not done', 'Mostly' are fixed English in workoutCompare.ts:54-58,132-146
Row is name + reason on the left and the tag on the right; long names and big font can squeeze the tag
Workouts saved before per-set Counting (T76) fall back to the exercise's Counting now (workoutCompare.ts:194)

why_not: phone-only: the comparison is only drawn on the phone finish screen (app/session/finish.tsx:329); the watch does not show it

start: Workout tab, a member with two folders, one followed ('Push Pull Legs'), and routines in each

steps.action: Open the Workout tab
user_sees: 'Routines' heading with 'New routine'
'Push Pull Legs (6)' open, tagged 'Following'; the other folder shut
Each routine card: name, a grey line of its exercises, the 'Next' tag on the routine Up next names, 'Start routine'
must_not: Two routines tagged 'Next'
A 'Following' tag on a folder the member does not follow
The followed folder anywhere but first

steps.action: Tap the shut folder's title
user_sees: It opens and shows its routine cards
must_not: Another folder shutting by itself
The open or shut choice forgotten after leaving the tab

steps.action: Open a routine's ... menu and tap 'Move down'
user_sees: The routine one place lower at once
must_not: The routine jumping to another folder
The new order lost after reopening the app

steps.action: Tap 'New routine'
user_sees: A question which folder it goes in, with 'My routines' offered first
must_not: The new routine put into the followed plan without asking

start: Another way in: a folder's ... menu

steps.action: Open the ... menu of a folder that is not followed
user_sees: 'Rename folder', 'Add new routine', 'Share folder', 'Move folder up' / 'Move folder down' where it can move, 'Easy weeks...' with On or Off, 'Follow this plan', 'Delete folder' in red
must_not: 'Move folder up' on a folder that is already at the top
'Share folder' on an empty folder

steps.action: Tap 'Follow this plan'
user_sees: The folder opens and moves first, tagged 'Following'
must_not: Two folders tagged 'Following'
Up next still naming a routine of the old plan

start: Another way in: a routine's 'Move to folder...'

steps.action: Open a routine's ... menu and tap 'Move to folder...'
user_sees: A list of every other folder
must_not: The folder it is already in offered as a target

steps.action: Pick a folder
user_sees: The routine in the picked folder; both folder counts change
must_not: The routine shown in both folders
The count in '(n)' not matching the cards

start: A move that is not possible, an empty routine, and a save that fails

steps.action: Open the ... menu of the top routine of a folder
user_sees: No 'Move up' row
must_not: 'Move up' shown and doing nothing

steps.action: Open the ... menu of the followed folder
user_sees: No 'Move folder up' or 'Move folder down'
must_not: The followed folder moved below another

steps.action: Tap 'Start routine' on a routine with 'No exercises yet'
user_sees: The routine's edit page opens instead of a workout
must_not: An empty workout started

steps.action: Move a routine while the save fails
user_sees: 'Could not save the new order'
must_not: The new order shown as saved when it was not

start: Delete a folder, delete a routine, and stop following

steps.action: Folder ... menu, 'Delete folder'
user_sees: 'Delete 'Push Pull Legs' folder?' with 'It'll be gone forever. Its 6 routines go too. Your workout history stays. You stop following this plan.'
'Delete' in red
must_not: The folder deleted before 'Delete' is tapped
Workout history deleted with the folder

steps.action: Routine ... menu, 'Delete routine', tap 'Delete'
user_sees: 'Delete '<name>'?' with 'The routine and its exercise list go. Your workout history stays.'
The card gone
must_not: Past workouts of that routine gone from History

steps.action: Followed folder ... menu, 'Stop following', confirm
user_sees: 'Stop following '<name>'?' with 'Up next then comes from the routine you did last...'
The 'Following' tag gone
must_not: Up next still reading the old plan's rotation

why_not: nothing leaves the phone in these steps; sharing a folder or routine is its own share flow (WorkoutRoutines.tsx:411, setSharing)

note: No folder: New routine goes to 'My routines' (workoutTab.ts:162); one folder not followed goes straight in; remembered open map stops at 300 folders (workoutTab.ts:84-95)
Follow this plan starts its weeks from todayISO() (WorkoutRoutines.tsx:418)
Moves show the new order at once and save after (WorkoutRoutines.tsx:369-397); a fast second tap or a close mid-save can leave screen and saved order apart
Menu, tag and question words are fixed English in workoutTab.ts:184-231
Folder title with '(n)' and a tag on one row; menus use 48 dp rows at 200% text (workoutTab.ts:19-20)
A stored open/shut map from an old version is cleaned to booleans only (workoutTab.ts:87-98)

why_not: routines and folders are edited only on the phone's Workout tab; the watch starts a routine but has no folder menus (unknown beyond this file)
